subject: POC activation handoff & load dry-run — scheduling and reschedule
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@veridian.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@veridian.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — Veridian / Redwood

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. The Veridian product and platform teams are eager to run a hands-on POC so we can validate prompt routing, prompt templates, and do a small-scale load dry-run before we commit to Dedicated capacity.

High-level asks:
- 90–120 minute kickoff + hands-on session with prompt review and routing walkthrough
- Follow with a 60-minute load dry-run (simulated traffic, 50–200 concurrent streams depending on profile)
- Success criteria: routing accuracy for top-3 intents, end-to-end latency under 350ms median for our sample prompts, and basic KV cache behavior under load

Availability from our side: week of June 14 — June 18. Primary stakeholders: myself (product), Ben Turner (platform), and our contractor lead (will loop procurement for calendar).

Can you propose 2–3 slots? Also please send any pre-reads and a simple load plan template we can fill out.

Thanks,
Alicia

Alicia Gomez
Senior PM, Conversational AI
Veridian, Inc.
Alicia.Gomez@veridian.com
[phone redacted]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — Veridian / Redwood

Hi Alicia — great to hear, we can definitely run that flow.

Proposed schedule (all PT):
- Option A: Tue, Jun 15, 10:00–12:00 — kickoff + hands-on prompt walkthrough (team intros, goals, prompt design, routing rules, short test prompts)
- Option B: Wed, Jun 16, 13:00–15:00 — same agenda
- Load dry-run: Thu, Jun 17, 11:00–12:00 — 60-minute load window we can start with 50 concurrent and step to 200

Quick agenda for kickoff (we'll tailor once you confirm):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) Prompt and routing review (30m)
3) Live hands-on: run sample prompts + tweak templates (40m)
4) Short Q/A + next steps (10m)

Attachments: kickoff-playbook-v1.pdf (pre-read), load-plan-template.xlsx (simple fields for concurrency, prompt sets, sample payloads).
Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij
Calendly (alternate): https://calendly.com/rafael-redwood/poc-kickoff

Marissa and Karthik — can you confirm lab availability for Jun 15/16 and the test harness readiness for Jun 17?

Alicia — if either slot works share final attendee list and any compliance contacts (if you want SOC/Security on call).

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Lab cluster is booked on 15th morning for another engagement; we can support the Jun 15 slot in the afternoon only (13:00 PT).
- Jun 16 at 13:00 PT looks open for both hands-on and runbook availability.
- For the load dry-run we should ask Veridian how many unique prompt templates and average token lengths so we can shape the step-up plan. I'll prepare a small test harness checklist.

Rafael — thanks for the options. Our execs have a calendar conflict on the 15th afternoon; can we move the hands-on to Thu, Jun 17 at 11:00 PT and then do the load dry-run on Fri, Jun 18 at 10:00 PT instead? That gives us room to collect feedback from the hands-on.

Confirmed attendees: Alicia Gomez (PM), Ben Turner (Platform), Rajesh Patel (prompt lead, rajesh.patel@veridian.com). Procurement copied for any contract/NDAs.

Success criteria (for the kickoff + small run):
- Top-3 intents routed to correct handler >= 92% in sample set
- Median response latency < 350ms for 75% of prompts in our test set
- No KV cache evictions on short runs (<10k tokens total)

I've attached a short doc with our priorities. Please send final calendar invite and any pre-reads to circulate internally.

Thanks,
Ben Turner
Platform Lead, Veridian, Inc.
[Attachment: veridian-priorities.docx]
